GrandWorld:
-- KAGEBOUND Grand World v0.1. Server builds a connected exploration greybox.
-- Art anchors ART-001..ART-004; source of truth docs/WORLD_VISION.md.
-- This is a test environment, NOT final hand-modeled land or production streaming.
local Workspace=game:GetService("Workspace")
local Lighting=game:GetService("Lighting")
local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local cfg=require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("KageboundShared"):WaitForChild("WorldConfig"))
if not cfg.Enabled then return end
local previous=Workspace:FindFirstChild("KageboundWorld")
if previous then previous:Destroy() end
local world=Instance.new("Folder")
world.Name="KageboundWorld"
world.Parent=Workspace
local rootByName={}
local p=cfg.Palette
local function block(parent,name,size,cf,color,material,collides)
    local obj=Instance.new("Part")
    obj.Name=name
    obj.Size=size
    obj.CFrame=cf
    obj.Anchored=true
    obj.CanCollide=collides~=false
    obj.CanTouch=false
    obj.Material=material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    obj.Color=color
    obj.TopSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
    obj.BottomSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
    obj.Parent=parent
    return obj
end
local function ball(parent,name,pos,diameter,color)
    local part=block(parent,name,Vector3.new(diameter,diameter,diameter),CFrame.new(pos),color,Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,false)
    part.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
    return part
end
local function path(parent,from,to,width,color)
    local delta=to-from
    local midpoint=(from+to)*.5
    return block(parent,"WalkablePath",Vector3.new(width,2,delta.Magnitude+4),CFrame.lookAt(midpoint,to),color,Enum.Material.Slate,true)
end
local function labelAt(parent,text,pos)
    local pole=block(parent,"MapMarker",Vector3.new(1,10,1),CFrame.new(pos),p.vermilion,Enum.Material.Wood)
    local gui=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    gui.Name="RegionName"
    gui.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(240,62)
    gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace=Vector3.new(0,9,0)
    gui.MaxDistance=300
    gui.AlwaysOnTop=true
    gui.Parent=pole
    local t=Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t.BackgroundColor3=p.ink
    t.BackgroundTransparency=.2
    t.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
    t.Text=text
    t.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(250,230,216)
    t.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
    t.TextScaled=true
    t.Parent=gui
end
local function torii(parent,x,z,size)
    local width=size*1.4
    for _,dx in ipairs({-width/2,width/2}) do
        block(parent,"ToriiPillar",Vector3.new(size*.13,size*1.4,size*.13),CFrame.new(x+dx,size*.7,z),p.vermilion,Enum.Material.Wood)
    end
    block(parent,"ToriiCrown",Vector3.new(width+size*.6,size*.15,size*.3),CFrame.new(x,size*1.43,z),p.vermilion,Enum.Material.Wood)
    block(parent,"ToriiBrace",Vector3.new(width,size*.08,size*.12),CFrame.new(x,size*1.12,z),p.ink,Enum.Material.Wood)
end
local function lantern(parent,x,z,accent)
    block(parent,"LanternPost",Vector3.new(1.4,7,1.4),CFrame.new(x,4,z),p.ink,Enum.Material.Wood)
    local light=block(parent,"Lantern",Vector3.new(3,3,3),CFrame.new(x,8.8,z),accent,Enum.Material.Neon,false)
    local point=Instance.new("PointLight")
    point.Color=accent
    point.Brightness=1
    point.Range=22
    point.Parent=light
end
-- One continuous walkable landmass, with roads to districts. No boxed-in battle arena.
block(world,"GrandWorldBase",Vector3.new(2700,7,2700),CFrame.new(0,-5,0),Color3.fromRGB(39,64,62),Enum.Material.Grass)
for _,z in ipairs(cfg.Zones) do
    local district=Instance.new("Folder")
    district.Name=z.id
    district.Parent=world
    rootByName[z.id]=district
    district:SetAttribute("Region",z.name)
    district:SetAttribute("Level",z.level)
    district:SetAttribute("Kind",z.kind)
    local baseY=.25
    block(district,"DistrictGround",Vector3.new(z.radius*2,1,z.radius*2),CFrame.new(z.x,baseY,z.z),z.tint,Enum.Material.Ground)
    block(district,"DistrictPlaza",Vector3.new(90,1,90),CFrame.new(z.x,1.25,z.z),p.stone,Enum.Material.Slate)
    labelAt(district,z.name.."  |  Lv "..z.level,Vector3.new(z.x,6,z.z-54))
    torii(district,z.x,z.z-78,22)
    for j=1,8 do
        local angle=(j/8)*math.pi*2
        lantern(district,z.x+math.cos(angle)*88,z.z+math.sin(angle)*88,z.accent)
    end
    if z.id=="KageDojo" then
        for i=1,6 do
            local a=i*math.pi/3
            local bx=z.x+math.cos(a)*120
            local bz=z.z+math.sin(a)*120
            block(district,"DojoHouse",Vector3.new(34,20,30),CFrame.new(bx,11,bz),p.ink,Enum.Material.Wood)
            block(district,"DojoRoof",Vector3.new(42,5,37),CFrame.new(bx,23,bz),p.vermilion,Enum.Material.Slate)
        end
        local spawn=Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
        spawn.Name="KageboundWorldSpawn"
        spawn.Anchored=true
        spawn.Neutral=true
        spawn.Size=Vector3.new(13,1,13)
        spawn.Position=Vector3.new(z.x,2.5,z.z)
        spawn.Duration=0
        spawn.Color=p.warm
        spawn.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
        spawn.Parent=district
    elseif z.id=="MoonfallBamboo" then
        for i=1,58 do
            local angle=i*2.399963
            local radius=120+(i%7)*23
            local x=z.x+math.cos(angle)*radius
            local zz=z.z+math.sin(angle)*radius
            local h=20+(i%5)*6
            block(district,"Bamboo",Vector3.new(1.6,h,1.6),CFrame.new(x,h/2+1,zz),Color3.fromRGB(47,107,73),Enum.Material.Wood,false)
            ball(district,"BambooCrown",Vector3.new(x,h+1,zz),5,Color3.fromRGB(41,81,67))
        end
    elseif z.id=="ShogunLastCity" then
        for i=1,14 do
            local x=z.x+((i-1)%5-2)*73
            local zz=z.z+(math.floor((i-1)/5)-1)*88
            local h=35+(i%4)*17
            block(district,"Tower",Vector3.new(33,h,33),CFrame.new(x,h/2+1,zz),p.ink,Enum.Material.Wood)
            block(district,"PagodaRoof",Vector3.new(44,4,44),CFrame.new(x,h+3,zz),p.vermilion,Enum.Material.Slate)
        end
    elseif z.id=="FrozenShrine" then
        for i=1,20 do
            local angle=i*2.399963
            local radius=105+(i%6)*29
            local x=z.x+math.cos(angle)*radius
            local zz=z.z+math.sin(angle)*radius
            local height=27+(i%4)*14
            block(district,"IceSpire",Vector3.new(13,height,13),CFrame.new(x,height/2+1,zz),z.accent,Enum.Material.Ice)
        end
    elseif z.id=="YomiRift" then
        for i=1,18 do
            local angle=i*2.399963
            local radius=100+(i%5)*28
            local x=z.x+math.cos(angle)*radius
            local zz=z.z+math.sin(angle)*radius
            local height=20+(i%5)*13
            block(district,"YomiMonolith",Vector3.new(10,height,10),CFrame.new(x,height/2+1,zz),p.ink,Enum.Material.Slate)
            ball(district,"SpiritWisp",Vector3.new(x,height+5,zz),4,p.spirit).Material=Enum.Material.Neon
        end
    end
    task.wait()
end
local roads=Instance.new("Folder")
roads.Name="TravelRoutes"
roads.Parent=world
local lookup={}
for _,z in ipairs(cfg.Zones) do lookup[z.id]=z end
for _,edge in ipairs(cfg.Routes) do
    local a,b=lookup[edge[1]],lookup[edge[2]]
    if a and b then
        local start=Vector3.new(a.x,1.7,a.z)
        local finish=Vector3.new(b.x,1.7,b.z)
        path(roads,start,finish,24,p.stone)
        for i=1,5 do
            local alpha=i/6
            local pos=start:Lerp(finish,alpha)
            lantern(roads,pos.X+16,pos.Z+16,p.warm)
        end
    end
end
-- WorldSky.server.lua owns the global sky, Atmosphere and Lighting presets.
-- Do not overwrite its moonlit baseline or Veilfall transitions here.
print("[KAGEBOUND] Grand World generated: "..#cfg.Zones.." connected regions")

RegionRules:
-- Pure region discovery policy for Grand World P1.
local World=require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("KageboundShared"):WaitForChild("WorldConfig"))
local Regions={}
function Regions.At(position)
    if typeof(position)~="Vector3" then return nil end
    local closest=nil
    local distance=math.huge
    for _,zone in ipairs(World.Zones) do
        local dx=position.X-zone.x
        local dz=position.Z-zone.z
        local d=dx*dx+dz*dz
        if d<=zone.radius*zone.radius and d<distance then
            closest=zone
            distance=d
        end
    end
    return closest
end
function Regions.ById(id)
    if typeof(id)~="string" then return nil end
    for _,zone in ipairs(World.Zones) do
        if zone.id==id then return zone end
    end
    return nil
end
function Regions.IsConnected(a,b)
    if a==b then return Regions.ById(a)~=nil end
    for _,route in ipairs(World.Routes) do
        if (route[1]==a and route[2]==b) or (route[2]==a and route[1]==b) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end
return Regions

-- Reuse the source-controlled v08 imports. Cosmetic draft placements, ART-004.
-- Existing GrandWorld geometry retains collision and traversal authority.

LandscapeRules:
-- Deterministic clearance policy for additive terrain. No player state or rewards.
local Rules = {}
function Rules.DistanceToSegment(point, a, b)
    local delta = b-a
    if delta.Magnitude == 0 then return (point-a).Magnitude end
    local t = math.clamp((point-a):Dot(delta)/delta:Dot(delta), 0, 1)
    return (point-(a+delta*t)).Magnitude
end
function Rules.CanPlaceHill(point, radius, zones, routes)
    local byId = {}
    for _, zone in ipairs(zones) do
        byId[zone.id] = Vector2.new(zone.x, zone.z)
        -- Reserves plaza, training and existing NPC/enemy gameplay space.
        if (point-byId[zone.id]).Magnitude < radius+125 then return false end
    end
    for _, edge in ipairs(routes) do
        local a,b=byId[edge[1]],byId[edge[2]]
        if a and b and Rules.DistanceToSegment(point,a,b) < radius+40 then return false end
    end
    return true
end
return Rules
WorldLandscape:
-- Five authored regional landscapes, ART-001/004 and WORLD_VISION.
-- Native Terrain is additive and route-aware; never clears pre-existing terrain.
local Shared=game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("KageboundShared")
local Config=require(Shared:WaitForChild("WorldConfig"))
if not Config.Enabled then return end
local Rules=require(Shared:WaitForChild("LandscapeRules"))
local Clone=require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("CosmeticWorldArt")).Clone
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("KageboundWorld",60)
if not world or world:FindFirstChild("RegionalLandscapes") then return end
local library=game.ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("KageboundStoreArt")
local source=game.ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("KageboundWorldArtV08")
local fullRoofSource=game.ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("KageboundWorldV05")
local root=Instance.new("Folder");root.Name="RegionalLandscapes";root.Parent=world
local Terrain=workspace.Terrain
local zones={}
for _,z in ipairs(Config.Zones) do zones[z.id]=z end
local palette=Config.Palette
local function part(parent,name,size,cf,color,material,collision)
    local p=Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name=name;p.Size=size;p.CFrame=cf;p.Color=color;p.Material=material
    p.Anchored=true;p.CanCollide=collision==true;p.CanTouch=false;p.CanQuery=collision==true
    p.TopSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth;p.BottomSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
    p.Parent=parent
    return p
end
local function prefab(parent,name,position,yaw,scale,tint)
    local template=(library and library:FindFirstChild(name)) or (source and source:FindFirstChild(name))
        or (fullRoofSource and fullRoofSource:FindFirstChild(name))
    if not template then return nil end
    local copy=Clone(template)
    if not copy then return nil end
    if copy:IsA("Model") then copy:ScaleTo(copy:GetScale()*(scale or 1)) end
    if name=="dojo_curved_roof" and copy:IsA("Model") then
        -- v05 roofs are authored at pavilion eave height, not at ground zero.
        -- Normalize a detached roof's base before placing it on a new tower.
        local box,size=copy:GetBoundingBox()
        copy.WorldPivot=CFrame.new(box.X,box.Y-size.Y/2,box.Z)
    end
    if tint then for _,p in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Color=tint end end end
    copy.Name=name
    copy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(yaw or 0),0))
    copy.Parent=parent
    return copy
end
local function stairs(folder,z,x,startZ,count,width,rise)
    for i=0,count-1 do
        part(folder,"WalkableStair",Vector3.new(width,.8,4.2),CFrame.new(z.x+x,1.76+i*rise,z.z+startZ+i*4),palette.stone,Enum.Material.Slate,true)
    end
end
local function lantern(parent,pos)
    return prefab(parent,"StoneLantern",pos,0,.8)
end
local function solidRoof(parent,position,width,depth,height)
    for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
        local wedge=Instance.new("WedgePart")
        wedge.Name="WalkableCurvedRoofCore";wedge.Size=Vector3.new(width,height,depth/2)
        wedge.CFrame=CFrame.new(position+Vector3.new(0,height/2,side*depth/4))
            * CFrame.Angles(0,side==1 and math.pi or 0,0)
        wedge.Color=Color3.fromRGB(48,48,72);wedge.Material=Enum.Material.Slate
        wedge.Anchored=true;wedge.CanCollide=true;wedge.CanTouch=false;wedge.Parent=parent
        part(parent,"VermilionEave",Vector3.new(width+1,.5,.7),CFrame.new(position+Vector3.new(0,.2,side*depth/2)),palette.vermilion,Enum.Material.Wood,false)
    end
    part(parent,"GoldRoofRidge",Vector3.new(width+.8,.4,.5),CFrame.new(position+Vector3.new(0,height,0)),palette.warm,Enum.Material.Metal,false)
end
local function timberFacade(parent,body)
    -- Broad plaster panels and timber rhythm read at gameplay distance.
    for side=0,3 do
        local width=side%2==0 and body.Size.X or body.Size.Z
        local depth=side%2==0 and body.Size.Z or body.Size.X
        local face=body.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(0,side*math.pi/2,0)*CFrame.new(0,0,-depth/2-.12)
        part(parent,"ShojiPlaster",Vector3.new(width-1,body.Size.Y-2,.15),face,Color3.fromRGB(169,157,174),Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,false)
        for _,x in ipairs({-width*.44,0,width*.44}) do
            part(parent,"TimberUpright",Vector3.new(.6,body.Size.Y,.35),face*CFrame.new(x,0,-.2),palette.vermilion,Enum.Material.Wood,false)
        end
        local floors=math.max(1,math.floor(body.Size.Y/12))
        for floor=0,floors do
            local y=-body.Size.Y/2+1+floor*(body.Size.Y-2)/floors
            part(parent,"TimberCrossbeam",Vector3.new(width,.65,.4),face*CFrame.new(0,y,-.25),palette.ink,Enum.Material.Wood,false)
        end
        for _,x in ipairs({-width*.24,width*.24}) do
            part(parent,"WarmShojiWindow",Vector3.new(3,4,.12),face*CFrame.new(x,body.Size.Y*.18,-.3),Color3.fromRGB(194,132,75),Enum.Material.Neon,false)
        end
    end
end
local function terrainRing(folder,z)
    local hills=0
    for i=1,18 do
        local a=i*math.pi*2/18+.12
        local radius=28+(i%4)*7
        local distance=z.radius-35+(i%3)*16
        local x,zz=z.x+math.cos(a)*distance,z.z+math.sin(a)*distance
        local height=z.id=="FrozenShrine" and 65+(i%4)*19 or 22+(i%4)*8
        -- Include the reused mesh footprint, not only the Terrain sphere.
        if Rules.CanPlaceHill(Vector2.new(x,zz),math.max(radius,height*.85),Config.Zones,Config.Routes) then
            local material=z.id=="FrozenShrine" and Enum.Material.Glacier or Enum.Material.Rock
            Terrain:FillBall(Vector3.new(x,1,zz),radius,material)
            Terrain:FillBall(Vector3.new(x,height*.35,zz),radius*.8,material)
            Terrain:FillBall(Vector3.new(x,height*.65,zz),radius*.55,material)
            local top=z.id=="FrozenShrine" and Enum.Material.Snow or Enum.Material.Grass
            if z.id~="YomiRift" then Terrain:FillBall(Vector3.new(x,height*.8,zz),radius*.45,top) end
            if z.id~="FrozenShrine" then prefab(folder,"Cliff",Vector3.new(x,0,zz),i*37,height/54) end
            hills+=1
        end
        if i%3==0 then task.wait() end
    end
    folder:SetAttribute("TerrainHills",hills)
end
for _,z in ipairs(Config.Zones) do
    local folder=Instance.new("Folder");folder.Name=z.id;folder.Parent=root
    folder:SetAttribute("Reference","ART-001/004 + WORLD_VISION")
    terrainRing(folder,z)
    if z.id=="KageDojo" then
        local district=world:FindFirstChild(z.id)
        if district then
            for _,building in ipairs(district:GetChildren()) do
                if building:IsA("BasePart") and building.Name=="DojoHouse" then timberFacade(folder,building)
                elseif building:IsA("BasePart") and building.Name=="DojoRoof" then
                    building.Transparency=1
                    solidRoof(folder,building.Position-Vector3.new(0,2,0),building.Size.X,building.Size.Z,7)
                    prefab(folder,"dojo_curved_roof",building.Position-Vector3.new(0,2,0),0,3.8)
                end
            end
        end
        -- Main shrine aligns with the existing lantern procession. Hide only the
        -- earlier decorative pavilion; its authoritative world geometry is untouched.
        local old=world:FindFirstChild("ImportedWorldArtV08")
        if old then local p=old:FindFirstChild("dojo_shrine_pavilion");if p then p:Destroy() end end
        prefab(folder,"GrandShrine",Vector3.new(0,1.76,-165),180,1)
        for _,x in ipairs({-52,52}) do
            for _,zz in ipairs({-120,-180}) do prefab(folder,"Bamboo",Vector3.new(x,1.76,zz),x,.8) end
        end
    elseif z.id=="MoonfallBamboo" then
        local district=world:FindFirstChild(z.id)
        if district then for _,p in ipairs(district:GetChildren()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name=="BambooCrown" then p.Transparency=1 end
        end end
        -- East shrine terrace leaves north/south travel and enemy center clear.
        stairs(folder,z,145,-45,18,12,.75)
        part(folder,"ShrineTerrace",Vector3.new(72,3,45),CFrame.new(z.x+145,13.75,z.z+45),palette.stone,Enum.Material.Slate,true)
        prefab(folder,"dojo_shrine_pavilion",Vector3.new(z.x+145,15.25,z.z+45),180,2.2)
        prefab(folder,"dojo_torii_signature",Vector3.new(z.x+145,1.76,z.z-55),0,2)
        for i=1,22 do
            local a=i*2.39996
            local d=95+(i%5)*22
            local x,zz=math.cos(a)*d,math.sin(a)*d
            if math.abs(x)>45 and not (x>110 and math.abs(zz)<80) then
                prefab(folder,"Bamboo",Vector3.new(z.x+x,1.76,z.z+zz),i*29,.75+(i%3)*.12)
            end
            if i%4==0 then task.wait() end
        end
        for _,zz in ipairs({-45,-10,25}) do lantern(folder,Vector3.new(z.x+133,2,z.z+zz)) end

WorldSky:
-- KAGEBOUND world sky: safe, complete-six-face cubemap switching for Moonfall and Veilfall.
-- Never install partial cubemaps or fabricate Roblox asset IDs.
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("KageboundShared")
local cfg = require(shared:WaitForChild("SkyConfig"))
local registry = require(shared:WaitForChild("RuntimeAssetRegistry"))
local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChild("KageboundSky")
if not sky then
    sky = Instance.new("Sky")
    sky.Name = "KageboundSky"
    sky.Parent = Lighting
end
local fields = {Bk="SkyboxBk", Dn="SkyboxDn", Ft="SkyboxFt", Lf="SkyboxLf", Rt="SkyboxRt", Up="SkyboxUp"}
local order = {"Bk","Dn","Ft","Lf","Rt","Up"}
local function asset(id)
    if type(id) == "number" and id > 0 and id % 1 == 0 then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
    end
    if type(id) == "string" and id:match("^rbxassetid://%d+$") then return id end
    return nil
end
local function resolve(variant)
    local faces = {}
    local configFaces = variant == "veilfall" and cfg.VeilfallFaces or cfg.Faces
    for _, key in ipairs(order) do
        local id = configFaces and asset(configFaces[key])
        local published = registry.get("ui.skybox." .. variant .. ".v01." .. string.lower(key))
        local resolved = id or asset(published)
        if not resolved then return nil end
        faces[key] = resolved
    end
    return faces
end
local moonfall = resolve("moonfall")
local veilfall = resolve("veilfall")
local function applyFaces(faces)
    if not faces then return false end
    for _, key in ipairs(order) do sky[fields[key]] = faces[key] end
    return true
end
local atmosphere = Lighting:FindFirstChild("KageboundAtmosphere")
if not atmosphere then
    atmosphere = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
    atmosphere.Name = "KageboundAtmosphere"
    atmosphere.Parent = Lighting
end
local function apply(veil)
    local values = veil and cfg.Veilfall or cfg.Atmosphere
    for property, value in pairs(values) do atmosphere[property] = value end
    if veil then
        -- If Veilfall faces are missing, retain the complete Moonfall sky instead of mixing faces.
        if not applyFaces(veilfall) then applyFaces(moonfall) end
    else
        applyFaces(moonfall)
    end
end
sky.CelestialBodiesShown = false
sky.StarCount = 2200
Lighting.ClockTime = 21.5
Lighting.Brightness = 2
Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(45, 39, 78)
Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(67, 62, 112)
if not moonfall then
    warn("[KAGEBOUND] Moonfall sky awaiting all six published image IDs; atmospheric fallback active")
end
if not veilfall then
    warn("[KAGEBOUND] Veilfall sky awaiting all six published image IDs; atmospheric transition only")
end
local function update()
    apply(Lighting:GetAttribute("KageboundVeilfall") == true)
end
update()
Lighting:GetAttributeChangedSignal("KageboundVeilfall"):Connect(update)
